description: NestJS enterprise architecture: modular design, controllers, services, guards, interceptors, pipes, and TypeORM/Prisma.
invariants: Use `@Injectable()` and constructor injection for all services — never instantiate services with `new`
Use DTOs for all request/response bodies; never pass raw `req.body` to services
Store all config values via `ConfigModule` and `process.env`; never hardcode them
